description: This file defines the React functional component 'PermissionsModalWrapper' which manages the state and visibility of a permissions modal within a web application. It handles presentation, dismissal, and event observation related to permissions dialogs.

methods.name: presentPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Callback to set the current permission dialog state

methods.name: dismissPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Callback to reset the permission dialog state to undefined

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Initializes the component's permission dialog handling when the application has started
